name: Pro Integration Tests
# Story PRO-5 - CI/CD Pipeline for aios-pro submodule
# Validates aios-core + aios-pro integration on every PR and push
# Maintains ADR-PRO-001: core CI stays standalone (no submodule checkout)

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'pro/**'
      - 'tests/pro/**'
      - 'bin/utils/pro-detector.js'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'pro/**'
      - 'tests/pro/**'
      - 'bin/utils/pro-detector.js'
  schedule:
    # Weekly at 6am UTC on Monday
    - cron: '0 6 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: pro-integration-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  NODE_VERSION: '20'

jobs:
  pro-integration-test:
    name: Pro Integration Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Check for Pro submodule token
        id: check-token
        run: |
          if [[ -z "${{ secrets.PRO_SUBMODULE_TOKEN }}" ]]; then
            echo "token_configured=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "⚠️ Pro submodule token not configured. Skipping integration tests."
          else
            echo "token_configured=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "✅ Pro submodule token found. Proceeding with integration tests."
          fi

      - name: Checkout Pro submodule
        if: steps.check-token.outputs.token_configured == 'true'
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: SynkraAI/aios-pro
          path: pro
          token: ${{ secrets.PRO_SUBMODULE_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        if: steps.check-token.outputs.token_configured == 'true'
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Pro integration tests
        if: steps.check-token.outputs.token_configured == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "=== Pro Integration Test Suite ==="
          npx jest tests/pro/ --verbose

      - name: Run Pro internal unit tests
        if: steps.check-token.outputs.token_configured == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "=== Pro Internal Unit Tests ==="
          find pro -name "*.test.js" -path "*/__tests__/*" | head -5 | while read test_file; do
            echo "Running: $test_file"
            npx jest "$test_file" --verbose || echo "⚠️ Test failed but continuing..."
          done

      - name: Test summary
        if: always() && steps.check-token.outputs.token_configured == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "=== Pro Integration Test Summary ==="
          echo "Tests executed for:"
          echo "  - Pro integration (core→pro)"
          echo "  - Pro internal unit tests"
          echo "  - Pro detector utilities"
          echo ""
          echo "Note: Pro submodule tests only run when PRO_SUBMODULE_TOKEN is configured."

      - name: Skip message
        if: steps.check-token.outputs.token_configured == 'false'
        run: |
          echo "⚠️ Pro submodule tests skipped due to missing token"
          echo "To enable Pro tests, add PRO_SUBMODULE_TOKEN to repository secrets"
